judgments.rationale: This is the home page of python.org.br, the Python Brasil community portal. Its <title> 'Python Brasil' names the site, and on a site's home page the site name is the page's topic. Inner pages follow the pattern 'Python Brasil-<topic>'. The title describes the page as 2.4.2 requires. The patch only rewords it, and wrongly, by calling the page 'Associação Python Brasil - Comunidade e Conferência'.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: This is the 'Aprenda mais' tile in the home page grid ('Aprenda mais' plus 'Conheça mais sobre a linguagem e torne-se um verdadeiro pythonista.'). It goes to /web, which is the first entry of the site's 'Aprenda mais' menu (Web, Mobile, Games, Científico, Wiki), the same way each sibling tile opens the first page of its menu. The destination, 'Python para desenvolvimento Web', is a page of courses, tutorials and documentation for learning Python web frameworks. The link's purpose, learning more about Python, can be determined and is not misleading. That the landing page is narrower than the tile's wording is an information-architecture point. 2.4.4 does not require the link text to repeat the destination's title.
